name: DWI Phase Encoding Polarity
description: Validates phase encoding direction polarity. Spine-generic DWI uses P-A (posterior to anterior) phase encoding. Siemens: PhaseEncodingDirectionPositive=0, GE: RectilinearPhaseEncodeReordering=REVERSE_LINEAR. Philips does not encode polarity in DICOM. (From the Generic Spine Protocol schema.)
